dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Presence of at least four distinct 'O' and 'C' shaped light-pixel perimeters on a dark-pixel background; geometry is characterized by sharp, jagged transitions from low-intensity exterior fur to high-intensity edges, with centers containing low-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of irregular, solid high-intensity light-pixel clusters located on the mid-lateral flank, exhibiting minimal internal gradient and high core pixel concentration.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent macro-annuli on the upper-left dorsal flank form a scalene triangle with its longest axis oriented approximately 45 degrees to the dorsal ridge.
